summary: Guardian of the Gulch: a 25-foot Helena tower used for fire watch until 1931, arson-damaged in 2016, then rebuilt on a new frame and rededicated.

facts.design: 25-foot wooden tower with an octagonal cab added in 1886; rebuilt on a new frame with the original cab

staffing.status: manned around the clock until last used in 1931

access.note: City park with a hiking trail up from Cruse Avenue; no source found on whether visitors may go inside or climb the tower

visit.trail_note: Hiking trail up to the tower from Cruse Avenue, just across Broadway

events.note: NHLR and the Visit Helena listing give 1876 (second tower on the site); firelookout.com gives 1869; Montana Free Press gives 1874
Fire suspected to be lightning-caused damaged the tower; repaired
Arson fire in August damaged the southwest strut
City announced demolition and replacement with a similar structure (February 2017); not carried out after public outcry
Friends of the Fire Tower nonprofit formed
Rebuilt on a new frame with the original cab; work finished in May and rededicated. Year taken from the April 2025 Montana Free Press timeline

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Visit Helena listing both give 1876, so the story uses 1876 and reports the 1869 (firelookout.com) and 1874 (Montana Free Press) dates as disagreements.
Montana Free Press reports a $424,383 contract awarded in November; KTVH reports a bid award of nearly $386,000. Not reconciled; the story reports both.
Montana Free Press says renovation began in January; KTVH says reconstruction began in December. Not reconciled; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Build year is the main conflict: 1869 (firelookout.com), 1874 (Montana Free Press), 1876 (register and Visit Helena listing). The brief's record of 1876 is kept. Restoration cost and start month conflict as noted. The year 2025 for the restoration is inferred: the Free Press story is dated April 7, 2025 and says the work was expected to finish by the end of May, and KTVH does not print a year. The city's restoration project page (helenamt.gov) returned no text. Whether the public may climb the tower is unknown. Pages read: 6 (NHLR, Visit Helena listing, firelookout.com, Montana Free Press, mthistory.org, KTVH). Search: 1 query.
